# asc_container (Data Source)

Retrieves a single container deployment in the ASC platform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the container deployment.

### Read-Only

- `args` (List of String) Arguments passed to the container command.
- `command` (String) The command to run in the container.
- `env` (List of String) Environment variables for the container (e.g. ["KEY=value"]).
- `group` (String) The group that the container is running as.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the container deployment.
- `image` (String) The image used by the container.
- `port` (Number) The port exposed by the container.
- `replicas` (Number) The number of replicas.
- `tags` (List of Object) Tags to attach to the container deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `tenant_id` (String) The identifier of the tenant that owns the container deployment.
- `user` (String) The user that the container is running as.
- `working_dir` (String) The working directory inside the container.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
